absence.detail: No boundary-target source is wired into the foundation trainer. Real BEM surfaces, source spaces and forward solutions ARE on disk (mne-sample subject `sample` 3-layer BEM + sol, mne-somato sub-01, mne-spm-face `spm`, and an fsaverage template head under ~/mne_data), and 31 digitised electrode files exist in ds004024. They are reachable only from tests/observe: the training EEG head calls scwbd.foundation.heads.build_lead_field, which looks for names scwbd/observe/__init__.py does not export, and falls back to provenance `analytic_sphere_fallback` -- a homogeneous single sphere with real standard_1005 electrode geometry and nothing else. No phantom data exists anywhere in the repository.
absence.consequence: Tier 2 is represented in this run by the montage calibration factor alone. No lead-field or head-model claim is available from this artifact.

absence.detail: Every registered real population-prior dataset is unavailable: ukbiobank-brain-imaging (MTA + fees), hcp-young-adult (ConnectomeDB terms), adni (DSPC application). None was downloaded, so tier 3 is represented in this run by the derived anatomy prior only.
absence.consequence: No population-level anatomical generalisation claim is available.

absence.detail: BLOCKING. The anatomy prior's card declares `is_simulated: false` and the object the trainer loads reports provenance `synthetic_fallback` with is_biological() == False. The 3.3 GB of real ENIGMA/HCP assets are on disk and BrainPrior.load() succeeds; scwbd/foundation/anatomy.py:193 reads obj.weights where the field is obj.structural.weights, the exception is swallowed, and the run silently gets a synthetic ellipsoid. Refusal X09 fires on this config for exactly that reason and this run must not launch until it is fixed. Note the shapes differ (454 synthetic regions vs 414 real parcels), so adopting the real prior also requires regenerating the simulated corpus.

bold.* is frozen for every source in this run. Three independent reasons, none of which is a preference: (a) the only measured modality available is EEG, whose expected Fisher information for beta_hrf, c_under and gain_bold is exactly 0.0 in all three identifiability regimes; (b) the simulated slow/BOLD tier was never generated; (c) the 663 MB of real BOLD on disk (ds000117, 2 subjects, 18 runs) has no loader. In 001-beta the simulator was the sole author of the haemodynamic head.
absence.consequence: bold.* stays at its compiled initialisation. No haemodynamic, fMRI-forecast or cross-modal-fusion claim is available from this artifact -- which is what was already true of 001-beta, stated rather than left to be inferred.
